{{Quote|Still live on Syngia some monstrosities do. Properly warned, all Knights should be.|Yoda's annotation in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Syngia''' was a celestial body located in the [[Syngia system/Legends|Syngia system]] of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]], which connected it to the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna]] and [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Syngia was where the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] practiced his mastery over the creation of life, and where he left behind his mysterious [[Genesis pool]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The Genesis Pool}}</ref>

Mutated creatures, descended from those created by [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was aware of these beasts, and warned other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of their existence through a notation in his copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP" />
